services.desc: An opportunity for audiences ages 13-18 to get an up-close and personal experience of Arden’s mainstage productions. For select performances (listed below), teens can attend an Arden show for just $15 followed by an exclusive post-show talkback with artists involved in the production. In a run-down boarding house in Duluth, Minnesota, strangers cross paths - experiencing love, loss, and everything in between.
